description: Famous for its blue fire and acidic crater lake.

name: Taman Nasional Baluran
description: Often called the Africa of Java, known for its extensive savanna and wildlife.

description: Beautiful beach with a distinctive red hill and great surf breaks.

name: Gandrung Sewu
description: A spectacular annual cultural festival featuring thousands of Gandrung dancers on the beach.

name: Banyuwangi Ethno Carnival
description: A vibrant annual carnival showcasing local culture, traditional arts, and extravagant costumes.

name: Sego Tempong
description: Traditional spicy rice dish served with boiled vegetables, fried tofu, tempeh, and a very spicy sambal.

name: Rujak Soto
description: A unique and delicious blend of Rujak (fruit/vegetable salad with peanut sauce) and Soto (traditional beef soup).

name: Osing Traditional Village
description: Experience the unique culture, architecture, and coffee of the indigenous Osing people of Banyuwangi.

name: Alas Purwo National Park
description: Dense, mystical monsoon forest known for its biodiversity, sacred caves, and legendary surf breaks.
